upstreamDescription: Implements Google Cast support in Android apps using Jetpack Media3. Handles adding build dependencies, updating manifest, configuring OptionsProvider, and managing CastPlayer or RemoteCastPlayer for playback in both Compose and View-based UIs. Use when adding Cast functionality or migrating from legacy Cast SDK to Media3 Cast.
